extra.reason: Built cube viewer: shadow-cljs project with 3D cube, warm-orange point light, Lambert shading, and X/Y/Z rotation sliders. Compiles cleanly with 0 warnings.

Light source now movable via three new sliders (X/Y/Z, -5..5). light-pos lives in the state atom; shade and draw-light-glow! take it as a parameter. Glow also scales with depth and hides when the light is behind the camera.

Built landing/ shadow-cljs project. Renders cards for ball + cube with live animated previews (real bouncing physics + rotating wireframe). Release build compiles clean, dev server serves index correctly to browsers (shadow-cljs content-negotiates on Accept: text/html).
Drag adds X/Y rotation (mouse-Y → :rx, mouse-X → :ry, 0.5°/px), scroll wheel zooms via :cam (clamped 2.5..20). Drag and sliders stay in sync via sync-slider!. Canvas shows grab/grabbing cursor.
